overall: MARGINAL this morning, turning GOOD from about noon to 9 PM
limiterDetail: The main limiter this morning is a combination: easterly wind 12–14 kt (gusts 17–20) in the west, showers about 6–11 AM, and dawn currents of 0.9–1.2 kt at Decabaitot, Alava, Barangonan and Culion. All three ease by late morning. From about noon most grounds drop to 2–6 kt with currents 0.0–0.4 kt and little rain.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA (latest entries are Davao Region gale advisories, last one marked final). The feed still lists a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Monday's dip is milder and Tuesday recovers: Mon 2 supply is now SLIGHTLY SOFT (was a SOFT dip) and Tue 3 is NEAR NORMAL (was slightly soft). Today is much drier than expected (4.5–12.6 mm over 24h, was 8.7–28.7) and the wind goes nearly calm from about noon to 9 PM. Monday itself also looks easier (8.9 kt, gusts 14, was 11 kt gusts 17).

The soft spot moves to Wed 4, now SLIGHTLY SOFT (Tuesday now 12 kt, gusts 17, was 11). Today Sun 1 stays SLIGHTLY SOFT. This morning's grounds read 0 GOOD / 12 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (yesterday 2 PM: 3 GOOD / 12 MARGINAL / 1 POOR), because of a 12–14 kt easterly, early showers and strong dawn currents in the west. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Sun–Sat (guide only). Tightening risk is lighter than yesterday: no full SOFT day left, just slightly soft arrivals today, Monday and Wednesday. Buy from Tuesday's landings, and today lean on Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Linapacan, Panlaitan and the Coron side after noon.
